Name: NPC_ARENA_GAME_EFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines NPC arena in-match UI and display parameters.

Fields.Name: Pop-up Text ID: Start
Fields.Description: Text effect shown when the match starts.

Fields.Name: Pop-up Text ID: Win
Fields.Description: Text effect shown when the player wins.

Fields.Name: Pop-up Text ID: Lose
Fields.Description: Text effect shown when the player loses.

Fields.Name: Pop-up Text ID: Draw
Fields.Description: Text effect shown when the match is a draw.

Fields.Name: Win/Loss Text Timing
Fields.Description: When the win/loss text is shown at the end of the match.

Fields.Name: Win/Loss Cutscene Delay
Fields.Description: Wait before the cutscene plays at the end of the match. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Slow-Motion Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time for the slow-motion effect. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Win/Loss Text Duration
Fields.Description: Duration to display win/loss dialogue, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Player Death: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text to display on player destruction.

Fields.Name: Player Death: Text Duration
Fields.Description: Duration to display text after player destruction, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Enemy Death: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text to display on enemy destruction.

Fields.Name: Enemy Death: Text Duration
Fields.Description: Duration to display text after enemy destruction, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Startup Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: Cutscene played when the match starts up.
